looks.name: Geri-Action
looks.note: Pulled from the Geri-Action key art: magenta-reds, blues and purples.

looks.name: Revelations
looks.note: Heaven's cool steel against Earth's warm gold, with the project's ember tones.

looks.name: Invalid Opinion
looks.note: The comedy's electric blue and indigo with a hot-red pop from the key art.

looks.name: Revision
looks.note: The red pen bleeding into a greyscale world: a glowing crimson ink-red against a cool grey-violet, lifted by a pale red highlight that echoes the pink smudges on skin.

looks.name: LoveBug
looks.note: Sun-baked retro romance from the poster's golden-hour Hollywood palette: warm coral-orange and amber (the orange VW Beetle, the lips, the vintage film grade) with a retro teal accent pulled from the palms.

looks.name: Miss Fortune
looks.note: The neon all-seeing-eye sign drives it: hot fortune-teller pink and an electric violet nightclub haze, warmed by the amber glow washing across her face.

looks.name: The Animator
looks.note: The hand-drawn storybook world made literal: the little orange clay character, a sunny sky-blue, and a soft paint-splatter pink for a cheerful, luminous pastel gradient.

looks.name: Hero's Journey
looks.note: Pure epic fire: the ember-orange and molten gold of the flames engulfing the bronze warrior helmet, resolving into a bright gold light for a heroic, blazing glow.

looks.name: Remember Me
looks.note: The film's nocturnal-blue interiors: a deep midnight blue and cool teal night light, warmed by the cream trench coat so the glow reads emotional rather than cold.

looks.name: Pity Party
looks.note: The dreamy Y2K poster: cotton-candy pink and baby-blue sky with a holographic lilac shimmer straight off the disco ball, for a bittersweet iridescent glow.

looks.name: Eddie's Order
looks.note: The magician's stage: his magenta-crimson suit paired with the golden glow of the enchanted hourglass and its warm spark shower, a rich theatrical gold-and-rose burn.

looks.name: The Hearts That Bleed & Bloom
looks.note: Bleed and bloom in one gradient: a deep arterial crimson opening into a blooming rose-pink and a pale blush, mirroring the crimson shirt and floral title art.

looks.name: Synesthesia
looks.note: The synesthetic color-glow spelled out in the logo itself: red, electric blue, and gold lens-flare light bleeding across a dark cosmos, the boldest neon gradient of the set.

looks.name: Geri Action
looks.note: Comic-book spy pop: the magenta-purple halftone backdrop and the heroine's red coat, sparked by the gold of her spy medallion for a punchy graphic-novel glow.

looks.name: Revelations
looks.note: The heavenly threshold: divine golden halo-light against the pale blue-grey clouds of the sky, rising to a soft cream radiance for a serene, celestial glow.

looks.name: Invalid Opinion
looks.note: The chromatic clash of the poster: the cold electric-blue 3D title and screen glow set against the hot red-orange room light, a high-voltage complementary gradient.
